clear: left after a left float

Text that must wrap into the space beside the float rather than under it, so the paragraph occupies the column to the right of the red box for as long as the float is alive.

clear: right after a right float

Text beside a right float. The float hangs on the right edge and this paragraph should fill the remaining width on the left before the orange bar clears it.

Two opposing floats, then clear: both

Text between a left float and a right float, squeezed into the middle column until the purple bar clears both.

clear: left must also pass a taller right float
